# M3b reuse acceptance rule under crossed parent × entry clustering

*Generated by `node experiments/lib/reuse-rule-sim.mjs --crossed --reps 20000 --seed m3b --need-reps 4000`. $0, no model call, seeded (beds/lib/rng.mjs). Simulation, not evidence about any gate. Monte Carlo SE at 5% is ±0.15 points (20000 draws per cell; p = 0 cells use 500). false kill = P(not served) at p = 0.01; miss = P(served) at p = 0.05. Model, allocations and estimands: the M3b header in experiments/lib/reuse-rule-sim.mjs; research/jit-20261008/DEV-NOTES.md D30.*

## Rules

- `aE`: the M3 rule as written into L4: one-sided exact bound, Deff by parent only, ρ_P = max(0.1, ρ̂_P)
- `aE0`: one-sided exact bound, no Deff
- `aEe`: Deff by entry only, ρ_E = max(0.1, ρ̂_E) (the verifier's "by entry")
- `aEx`: the larger of the two one-way Deffs, floors 0.1 and 0.1
- `aE2`: two-way Deff₂ = 1 + (m*_P − 1)ρ_P + (m*_E − 1)ρ_E, ρ_P = max(0.1, ρ̂_P), ρ_E = max(0.1, ρ̂_E)
- `aE2h`: two-way Deff₂ with the entry floor at 0.05
- `aE2g`: aE2 plus a per-entry guard (kill if any entry's Bonferroni exact lower bound > 0.05)
- `ref`: reference, not deployable: Deff₂ at the generator's true ICCs (no floor, no estimate)
